reading.title: Microbial Diversity in Extreme Environments
reading.passage: Microorganisms have demonstrated a remarkable capacity to thrive in environments that were once considered inhabitable by most life forms. Extremophiles, organisms that flourish in conditions of extreme temperature, pH, or salinity, have fundamentally altered our understanding of life's resilience. Deep-sea hydrothermal vents, with temperatures exceeding 400 degrees Celsius, harbor diverse microbial communities that derive energy from chemical reactions rather than sunlight. These thermophilic bacteria possess specialized proteins and cell membranes that remain stable under conditions that would denature proteins in ordinary organisms. The study of extremophiles has yielded practical applications in biotechnology, particularly in the development of heat-resistant enzymes used in polymerase chain reaction, a cornerstone technique in genetic research. Furthermore, the discovery of life in such hostile terrestrial environments suggests that similar microbial ecosystems might exist on other planets, particularly on Jupiter's moon Europa, where subsurface oceans may support chemosynthetic organisms.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is the primary energy source for microbial communities at hydrothermal vents?
options: A. Sunlight converted through photosynthesis
B. Chemical reactions in the surrounding water
C. Thermal energy from the Earth's core
D. Organic matter from dead organisms
questions.explanation: 지문에 'Deep-sea hydrothermal vents...harbor diverse microbial communities that derive energy from chemical reactions rather than sunlight'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 답은 B입니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about the proteins in extremophilic bacteria?
options: A. They are identical to proteins found in ordinary organisms
B. They have structural features that allow them to withstand extreme heat
C. They cannot function at temperatures below freezing
D. They were recently discovered to have no practical applications
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'These thermophilic bacteria possess specialized proteins and cell membranes that remain stable under conditions that would denature proteins in ordinary organisms'라고 했으므로, 극한 미생물의 단백질은 높은 열에 견딜 수 있는 특별한 구조를 가지고 있다는 것을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.q: The word 'harbors' in the passage is closest in meaning to
options: A. Controls or manages
B. Protects from danger
C. Contains or provides shelter for
D. Transports or carries away
questions.explanation: 'harbors'는 '포함하다' 또는 '보관하다'는 의미로, 이 문맥에서는 hydrothermal vents가 다양한 미생물 군집을 '포함하고 있다'는 뜻입니다. 따라서 'Contains or provides shelter for'가 가장 적절한 의미입니다.

questions.q: Why does the author mention the discovery of extremophiles in terrestrial extreme environments?
options: A. To demonstrate the failure of previous evolutionary theories
B. To suggest the potential existence of life on other planets
C. To criticize the use of enzymes in genetic research
D. To explain why all microorganisms require sunlight
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 문장에서 'the discovery of life in such hostile terrestrial environments suggests that similar microbial ecosystems might exist on other planets'라고 명시하고 있으므로, 저자는 지구의 극한 환경에서의 발견이 다른 행성에서의 생명 존재 가능성을 시사한다고 언급하고 있습니다.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer living in a city with convenient public transportation, entertainment, and job opportunities. Others prefer living in the countryside with fresh air, nature, and a slower pace of life. Which environment do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details in your response.
model_sentences: Personally, I prefer living in a city because of the numerous advantages it offers for my lifestyle and career development.
First, cities provide much better access to public transportation, which means I don't need to own a car and can save a lot of money on fuel and maintenance.
For example, I can take the subway or bus to go to work, school, or visit friends without worrying about parking or traffic congestion.
Additionally, cities offer more job opportunities and educational institutions, so I have more options for my future career.
Although countryside living has its appeal with nature and fresh air, I believe the convenience and opportunities in urban areas make it a better choice for me overall.

listening.title: Student Club Budget Discussion
listening.script: Student A: Hey, did you see the email about the club budget meeting next week? Student B: Yeah, I did. I'm actually pretty concerned about it. We need to talk about how we're spending money. Student A: What do you mean? I thought we had plenty of funds from last semester. Student B: Well, we did, but we spent a lot on the trip to the museum last month. Plus, we want to organize a big event for next semester, so we need to be careful. Student A: Oh, I see. So what are you suggesting? Student B: I think we should cut back on some smaller expenses and focus our budget on the main events that most members actually attend. Student A: That makes sense. Maybe we could reduce the budget for snacks at meetings? Student B: Exactly! And we could also ask members for small voluntary contributions for special events. Student A: Good idea. I'll bring these suggestions to the meeting. Thanks for thinking this through!

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
options: A. Planning a field trip to a museum
B. Discussing how to manage the club's budget and expenses
C. Comparing the costs of different club events
D. Deciding whether to increase membership fees
questions.explanation: 대화의 중심은 클럽의 예산 관리와 지출에 관한 것입니다. Student B가 기금 사용에 대해 걱정하고, 그들이 어떻게 돈을 쓸지에 대해 논의하고 있으므로 답은 B입니다.

questions.q: What does Student B suggest to manage the budget more effectively?
options: A. Cancel all special events until more money is available
B. Increase the membership fees immediately
C. Reduce expenses on smaller items and ask for voluntary contributions
D. Ask the school administration for additional funding
questions.explanation: Student B는 '작은 지출을 줄이고 특별 행사에 대해 자발적인 기여를 요청하자'고 제안합니다. 이는 대화의 후반부에서 명확하게 나타납니다.

questions.q: Why did Student B become concerned about the club's budget?
options: A. The museum trip cost more than expected
B. Members were complaining about the snack quality
C. Past spending and upcoming events required careful financial planning
D. The school reduced the club's funding for next year
questions.explanation: Student B는 지난달 박물관 여행에서 많은 돈을 썼고, 다음 학기에 큰 행사를 계획하고 있기 때문에 예산을 신중히 관리해야 한다고 말합니다. 따라서 과거 지출과 앞으로의 행사 때문에 걱정하고 있습니다.
